label: CRS328-24P-4S+RM
description: MikroTik CRS328-24P-4S+RM - 24x 1G RJ45 with 802.3af/at PoE-out and 4x 10G SFP+ cages, RouterOS or SwOS.

poe.note: MikroTik publishes current limits only: PoE-out ports Ether1-Ether24 (802.3af/at), low voltage limit 1000 mA / high voltage 450 mA, "Max total out (A) 20 A". No watt figure is printed, so the budget is left unknown rather than multiplied out.

notes: Vendor figures from the MikroTik product page specification table: 24x 10/100/1000 Ethernet ports with **PoE-out on Ether1-Ether24** (802.3af/at, 1000 mA low voltage / 450 mA high voltage per port, Max total out 20 A), 4x SFP+ ports (10G). The twenty-four copper ports were already modelled by the port template but carried no PoE claim at all, so the 24P behaved as an unpowered switch. The 24 copper ports are 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 sockets (spec table, row Ethernet: "10/100/1000 Ethernet ports: 24"); the template now declares that connector rather than leaving the cage to be inferred from the port name.
